0022600042.text: The Clippers (2-8, 2-3 at home, 0-5 on the road) are 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 7 games back, while the Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 5-0 at home, 3-3 on the road) are 6th in the West and 2nd in the Northwest. Ruled out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Cam Christie (ankle), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Clippers trail this season's series 0-1 and lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, 2026.
